subject: general
question: In March 2023, the Uttarakhand government had approved how much horizontal reservation for statehood activists in state government jobs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Uttarakhand government approved a **10%** horizontal reservation for statehood activists in state government jobs in March 2023.
 
• This reservation is aimed at recognizing and rewarding the contributions of those who were involved in the movement for Uttarakhand's statehood.
 
• Horizontal reservation is a category of reservation that cuts across all vertical reservations like SC, ST, OBC, etc., and is provided to specific groups such as women, differently-abled persons, and in this case, statehood activists.
 
• This initiative is part of the state government's efforts to honor the sacrifices and contributions of the statehood activists.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The state of Uttarakhand was formed on **9th November 2000**, becoming the 27th state of the Republic of India.
 
• The movement for statehood was marked by various protests and agitations, particularly in the 1990s, demanding a separate state to address the distinct socio-cultural and economic issues of the region.
 
• Horizontal reservations ensure that the benefits of reservation are extended to specific groups across all categories, enhancing inclusivity and representation.
 
• The decision to provide reservation to statehood activists reflects the government's commitment to acknowledging historical contributions and promoting social justice.
